single.rationale: Martin Marietta demonstrates solid fundamentals as a leading aggregates producer with strong market positions in high-growth megaregions and impressive safety performance. However, flat three-year revenue CAGR (-0.1%), high valuation multiples (34.6x P/E, 40.2x P/FCF), elevated net debt ($5.3B), and significant portfolio restructuring (asset sales/exchanges) amid cyclical construction market risks warrant monitoring rather than immediate deep commitment.
